name: 商汤小浣熊
desc: 能搞定工作的桌面 AI 智能体
desc_zh: 能搞定工作的桌面 AI 智能体
solves: Getting a folder of spreadsheets analyzed means uploading them to a web page and downloading the result. The files stay on your machine and it reads them directly.
solves_zh: 把一个文件夹的表格拖到网页里再下载结果，来回折腾。文件留在本机，它直接读进去跑完分析。
best_for: You have local files to summarize or compare that should not go up to a public site.
best_for_zh: 手头有一批本地文件要汇总、比对，且内容不适合上传到公网。
notes: 能直接读本地文件、自动跑分析的桌面智能体，累计服务超 2000 万用户 来源：https://www.sensetime.com/cn/news/-2
